description: Adds Moonshot's Kimi Code as a provider: run its threads from bb's provider picker, locally and on enrolled remote hosts. Turns stream into the native bb timeline — replies and tool calls such as file edits and shell commands — with resume and bb permission modes gating each action. The model picker fills from Kimi Code itself (K3, K3-256k, K2.8 Preview, K2.7 Code Highspeed), with thinking levels and the Default / Plan / Auto / YOLO mode selector. Kimi Code's slash commands (/compact, /status, /usage, and your own skill commands) appear in the composer menu. Requires the Kimi Code CLI and a signed-in account on each host (kimi login); the provider card can install the CLI where it is missing.
